Headline: #22 Clark and #62 Archer Temporary Northbound Reroute near Polk/Dearborn
ShortDescription: Northbound #22 Clark and Northbound #62 Archer buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Polk/Dearborn.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #22 Clark and Northbound #62 Archer buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Polk/Dearborn.

NB #22 Clark buses will operate via Clark, Polk, State, Ida B. Wells, Dearborn and over normal route.

NB #62 Archer buses will operate via Polk, Clark, Harrison, Dearborn, and over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.
